LABELS.Definition: names or words given to describe something

AGRARIAN.Definition: relating to farming and the land

TIMEKEEPING.Definition: measuring and recording the correct time

SLICE.Definition: a section or part cut from something larger

EXCEPTIONS.Definition: cases that did not follow the general rule

OFFSET.Definition: a difference from the usual whole-hour time

LEISURE.Definition: free time spent relaxing or doing things you enjoy

MAKE THE MOST OF.Definition: get as much benefit as possible from

PHENOMENON.Definition: an event or situation that people notice or live through

OUTBREAK.Definition: the sudden start of something such as a war

REVERTING.Definition: going back to an earlier system

PROPONENTS.Definition: people who support an idea or plan

RECREATIONAL.Definition: done for fun and relaxation in free time

FACTOR.Definition: something that affects a decision or result

OUTWEIGHED.Definition: more than cancelled out because something else is bigger

VEHEMENTLY.Definition: very strongly and with great feeling

ANNOYANCE.Definition: a thing that makes people feel irritated or a little angry

ANNOYING.Definition: making people feel irritated or a little angry

PRODUCTIVITY.Definition: how much work people get done

BENEFICIARIES.Definition: groups that gain advantages from something

RHYTHMS.Definition: regular patterns of sleeping, waking and activity

ACUTE.Definition: serious and difficult to deal with

PROPOSALS.Definition: suggestions or plans put forward for others to consider
